parts.text:
**Timer audit**

A grep over the test directory is enough here.

result.content:
test/webhooks.test.js:8:  await deliver({ url: 'https://example.com/hook' }, { fetch: fetchStub, backoffMs: 50 })
test/jobs.test.js:22:  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20))

parts.text: Two tests touch real timers: `test/webhooks.test.js` (indirectly, through `deliver()` back-off) and `test/jobs.test.js:22` (an explicit 20 ms sleep). The first is the flaky one; the second is harmless but could use a fake clock too.
